label: From decision tree to diagram
subgoals: Fix the variable order and assign one variable per level
Sum the levels to get 2^n - 1 decision nodes

label: Merging isomorphic subgraphs
subgoals: List the cofactors of f by the first i variables of the order
Keep one node per distinct cofactor on each level
Sum the distinct cofactors over the levels

label: Removing redundant tests
subgoals: Find nodes whose low and high children are the same
Delete them and redirect their parents to the child
Subtract the ROBDD count from the quasi-reduced count
